{{Quote|Our biggest, most stacked slider! Piled high with two patties, triple cheese, deep-fried Tapani triangles, mega-leaf lettuce, a slice of algae-bread, Boontaspiced mustard, plankton spread, larded neutrinos and a fried blubberbird egg, with a green jumbolive on top, it's just the thing to satisfy a Herglic-sized hunger.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Giju slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
A '''green jumbolive'''  type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that was used as an ingredient in the [[giju slider]]s served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[slider]] was created by the diner's [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] with inspiration from their travels<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> to the planet [[Giju/Legends|Giju]].<ref name="Dark Force Rising">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A green jumbolive was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
